slides.title: Case 1: which solar settings should we use?
slides.say: Imagine an operator comparing possible settings for solar units. Each choice changes power flows. The job is to find an acceptable option while respecting voltage, line-current and unit limits. An agent can organize the requests and responses, while the tool calculates the electrical effects. We first learn those tools in Colab, then inspect saved agent decisions.

slides.title: Case 2: who gets power after a fault?
slides.say: A fault removes one normal supply path. Alternative paths have limited capacity, so the operator must choose what to restore. Serving critical demand first can differ from maximizing the total power served. The agent can carry that priority into a study request, collect the result and request a new study when the situation changes.
